name: @denselink/openapi-core
description: OpenAPI contracts for Denselink (common + identity + product domains)

scripts.bundle:domains: mkdir -p src/.bundled && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.json && redocly bundle meshports --output src/.bundled/meshports.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle meshports --output src/.bundled/meshports.json && redocly bundle licenses --output src/.bundled/licenses.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle licenses --output src/.bundled/licenses.json && redocly bundle density --output src/.bundled/density.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle density --output src/.bundled/density.json && redocly bundle venues --output src/.bundled/venues.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle venues --output src/.bundled/venues.json && redocly bundle grants --output src/.bundled/grants.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle grants --output src/.bundled/grants.json && redocly bundle telemetry --output src/.bundled/telemetry.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle telemetry --output src/.bundled/telemetry.json && redocly bundle reports --output src/.bundled/reports.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle reports --output src/.bundled/reports.json
